q: while those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the Truth.

s: the Scripture is revealed with truth (by Allah)
q: Allah it is Who hath revealed the Scripture with truth, and the Balance.

s: the Lecture is a Arabic revelation (inspired in Muhammad)
q: And thus We have inspired in thee a Lecture in Arabic,

s: revelation is from Allah (delivered by revelation, from behind a veil, or through a messenger)
q: And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave.

s: religion is ordained for mankind (through Noah, Muhammad, Abraham, Moses and Jesus)
q: He hath ordained for you that religion which He commended unto Noah, and that which We inspire in thee (Muhammad), and that which We commended unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, saying: Establish the religion, and be not divided therein.

s: Allah is a the Mighty
q: He is the Strong, the Mighty

s: religion requires unity (not division)
q: Establish the religion, and be not divided therein.

s: Allah's mercy is spread His mercy (after they have despaired)
q: And He it is Who sendeth down the saving rain after they have despaired, and spreadeth out His mercy.

s: sin and indecency are shunned by believers (when they are among the worst sins and indecencies)
q: And those who shun the worst of sins and indecencies and, when they are wroth, forgive,

s: worship is established by believers (in answer to Allah's call)
q: And those who answer the call of their Lord and establish worship,

s: counsel governs the affairs of believers
q: and whose affairs are a matter of counsel,

s: the doom befalls wrong-doers (because of what they have earned)
q: Thou seest the wrong-doers fearful of that which they have earned, and it will surely befall them,

s: the path of Allah belongs to Allah
q: The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth.

s: Allah is a the Knower
q: Thus Allah the Mighty, the Knower inspireth thee (Muhammad) as (He inspired) those before thee.

s: Allah is a the Hearer
q: Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer.

s: Allah is a the Seer
q: Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer.
